headline: For any fixed finite collection of compensated macroscopic uniform rows near the isotropic Gaussian reflection, p_Q(0)/(3sqrt2)=1-(3 eps^2/80) sum alpha_j^2 F(t_j)+O(eps^3), F(t)=(19+2t-13t^2)/8>=1. At fixed total macro variance and fixed row count, the unique second-order cone-tip maximizer is equal fragmentation along the minority eigendirection. A two-noncollinear-row exact entrywise-dense spectrum-{1,1,-1} physical family approaches 3sqrt2 as q->0 after m->infinity.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: For the exact dense tetrahedral Parseval-frame Poisson family with lambda_a=R_a=1 and B=I-2nn^T, n=(1,2,4)/sqrt(21), limsup ||p_m||_inf <= 4.14563248192024416656... < 4.146 < 3sqrt2.

unresolved_implication: No proof that 3sqrt2 is the unrestricted sharp constant and no universal upper bound. Remaining sharp-witness mechanisms include nonperturbative multi-macro interactions, rough residual laws without a covariance-floor Gaussian core, and extra active spectrum surviving before rank-three aggregation.
next_step: Test nonperturbative two-or-more non-collinear macroscopic rows for off-zero/two-sheet overshoot; if no overshoot, seek a global comparison extending the perturbative rigidity beyond small epsilon.
